paper_title: SepLLM Accelerate Large Language Models by Compressing One Segment into   One Separator
caption: The loss comparison between vanilla Transformer and the proposed SepLLM. SepLLM achieves lower loss different computation costs and different training time consistently.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the relationship between TFLOPS and Loss for two different models, Vanilla and SepLLM. The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPS" and spans a linear scale from 0.00e+00 to 1.00e+09, with tick labels at regular intervals of 0.25e+09. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and spans a linear scale from 2.40 to 2.75, also with tick labels at regular intervals of 0.05. A solid purple line, marked with a triangle, represents the Vanilla model; the line begins at a value of 2.746 at x=0.00e+00 and decreases to approximately 2.542 at x=1.00e+09. A solid red line, marked with a circle, represents the SepLLM model; it begins at a value of 2.703 at x=0.00e+00 and decreases to a value of 2.483 at x=1.00e+09. A horizontal dashed line is shown at a value of 2.50 on the y-axis, spanning the entire x-axis.
